summary: The Romancing Star is a 1987 Hong Kong romantic comedy directed by Wong Jing. It stars Chow Yun-fat, Eric Tsang, Natalis Chan, Stanley Fung and Maggie Cheung. The film was followed by two sequels, The Romancing Star II and The Romancing Star III.
one_line: A 1987 Hong Kong romantic comedy directed by Wong Jing, starring Chow Yun-fat and Maggie Cheung, with two later sequels.

The Romancing Star II was released the year after the original film, in 1988.
